hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/sentinel.mjs" 2>/dev/null || if [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ENFORCEMENT_MODE" ] && [ "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ENFORCEMENT_MODE" != cooperative ] || [ "$(cat "$HOME/.config/arbiter/claude-mod/mode" 2>/dev/null)" = strict ]; then printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"LangGuard is not running in this session, so strict mode blocks this prompt. Common causes are Claude Code older than 2.1.287, a load error, or a crash. Update or restart Claude Code, or run /reload-plugins."}'; fi
